label: VARYING_DOMAINS_RIGID_IDENTITY_AND_NECESSITY_4 transfer rivals the CONTINGENT_1 node
note: Necessitist rival, analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Mechanism: on this profile the transfer is exactly increasing domains (boxAllToAllBox_iff), so membership in ExistsAt persists along every edge and no actual concrete being is absent at an accessible world, against the node. Positive account: necessitism (for navigation only: Williamson, Modal Logic as Metaphysics, 2013: necessarily everything is necessarily something), reading ExistsAt as the unrestricted quantifier domain. Independent justification: in classical quantified modal logic with unrestricted universal instantiation, necessitation and K, the converse Barcan formula, of which this transfer is the guarded pattern, is derivable, and it is valid exactly on increasing domains, so keeping that logic unrestricted commits one to the rival; Williamson adds an abductive case from the simplicity and strength of that logic and the argument that the proposition that x does not exist would itself require x. Contingentists reject the transfer because of contingent existents (Williamson's necessitism/contingentism labels; some self-described actualists, e.g. Linsky and Zalta, accept the Barcan and converse Barcan formulas). It strictly strengthens the recorded rival 411e5817 (concrete necessitarianism) at every world (transferGivesConcreteNecessary; strictness by Control.Strictness). Under its own reading the necessitist replaces contingent existence with contingent concreteness, which this profile's world-independent concrete predicate cannot express; that bridge is open.
